issues.description: The template defines a call to the Stim Circuit constructor with a float argument (stim.Circuit(p)) which does not match the Stim API usage in the solution (stim.Circuit()). This constructor parameter mismatch in the template can confuse students (they may try to run or edit the template and see an unexpected constructor usage) and is inconsistent with the solution and intended usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the spurious parameter when constructing a Stim circuit in the template. Use stim.Circuit() (no arguments) consistently in both template and solution. If the template intended to indicate a parameterized noise model, document that explicitly and provide the correct API usage elsewhere rather than passing p to stim.Circuit().
